prompt: Open 8K7F; I want the stretch from residue 50 to residue 61 of chain A in yellow and everything else white.

checks: schema-valid; replays with nothing ignored or unresolved (scripts/check_api_refs.py)

each of the 1 selection(s) selects exactly the atoms written a second time in provenance.targets (author chain, author number and residue name, or label chains / label ranges from the frozen facts), resolved by molbench.atoms
the reference grades as exactly right against the task (F1 1, success, target score 1)
a near miss (first colour changed, or last step dropped) is not a success and earns partial credit (F1 0.9)
equivalent answer succeeds: label chain and label range
wrong answer fails: the author numbers in start/end_residue_number (label numbering) (F1 0.7967)
provenance.derived: A seeded author-numbered range inside one run of a chain whose author and label numbers differ; kept only if the author range selects exactly the polymer residues of the matching label range (no water, ligand or insertion-coded residue shares the numbers).
